body.statement: Can the mixed-support atlas handle \(\mathscr A\) be completed so that, for every fixed finite \((\mathcal W,\mathcal Z)\) and every nonempty \(\mathcal C_A(T)\) or \(\mathcal C_B(T)\), it enumerates all labeled rank-one and rank-two incidence charts, inactive rows, coincident endpoints, residual forests, real algebraic components, and support faces; decides whether \(\tau_C\) agrees within and across them; and returns either an exact target value or a legal target-changing certificate, without using a generic two-copy quantifier-elimination predicate as the classification?
body.justification: This exhaustion and gluing problem is the single load-bearing open mathematical step.
body.gap: Neither causal proxy identification nor NMF rigidity literature supplies a global target-image classification across all boundary components of this labeled cycle.
body.consumer: Solving it turns sufficient regular identification into a complete decision rule for every legal finite anchor-model observable law.

obligation.what_is_open: An exhaustive response-cycle classification for every simultaneous rank-one, equal-endpoint, inactive-row, support-face, and IV residual pattern, including agreement across all real components, without a generic two-copy quantifier-elimination classifier.
obligation.obstruction: Rank-two segments and residual forest ratios do not control hidden split vectors on equal-endpoint rank-one cells.  With several inactive rows, endpoint propagation can stop, and lower-dimensional components can meet across faces with different target images.  The supplied draft explicitly has no exhaustion or gluing proof for these patterns.
obligation.attempted: Oriented rank-two boxes, distinct-endpoint projective transfers, a complete one-rank-one chart, residual-ratio forest propagation, exact mixed rational instances, and a cubic algebraic IV completion were checked.  These tests establish branches but do not enumerate every incidence geometry.
obligation.partial_result:
The closed part of the classification consists of two exact reductions.  When all four cells have rank two, the endpoint fiber is the union of at most \(2^4\) orientation boxes, and target constancy is equivalent to singleton intervals for response types \(1,2,4\) plus equality across boxes.  For every fixed cycle factorization in design B, positive unknown margins exist exactly under the residual proportionality, forest propagation, and active-cycle product conditions proved above.  The supplied exact regression additionally verifies a one-rank-one, three-rank-two chart and exhibits an algebraic design-B completion with projective coordinate equal to the isolated root in \((1,101/100)\) of
\[
45218q^3+108487q^2-278050q+124258=0.
\]
What remains unproved is an exhaustive structural propagation and gluing argument when several rank-one cells, equal endpoints, inactive incident rows, and residual support faces occur simultaneously.
